Great for beginners!|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Soldier''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires in bursts. It is an upgraded version of the [[Soldier]], obtained from the [[Golden Crate]] for {{Coins|50,000}}, if you own the [[Soldier]]. It can also appear in the Daily Skin Store for {{Coins|50,000}}. The '''Golden Soldier''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between each burst, though in Level 3 and 4, it will no longer fire in bursts and will instead auto fire like the [[Militant]]. It is a fairly cheap tower, so it can be used effectively in earlier [[waves]]. It gains flying detection at Level 0 and hidden detection at Level 2, so it is an effective counter against hidden and flying [[enemies]]. In comparison to its normal counterpart, the [[Soldier]], the '''Golden Soldier''' has flying detection immediately, more range, more damage, a higher burst, and a faster firerate on most Levels, but it is more expensive to place down and upgrade. Due to its cheap cost and efficient stats, it is considered an early to mid-game and late-game tower. Later on during the game, the '''Golden Soldier's''' effectiveness dwindles against high health enemies and is outclassed by other, stronger, towers. Despite this, it still acts as an effective anti-air option, as well as dealing with hordes of weaker enemies relatively quickly. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Trigger Finger|Cost = {{Money|150}}|Image = [[File:Soldier Upgrade 1 New.png|100px]]|Information = 0.15 > 0.12 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] 0.45 > 0.35 Cooldown [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|200}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Field Training|Cost = {{Money|800}}|Image = [[File:Soldier Upgrade 2 New.png|100px]]|Information = +1 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +3 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] +Hidden Detection {{Hidden|Hidden Detection}} 4 > 5 Burst [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Burst]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|466}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Gilded Gear|Cost = {{Money|3,400}}|Image = [[File:Soldier Upgrade 4 New.png|100px]]|Information = +2 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] 0.35 > 0 Cooldown [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|1,600}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 4|Upgrade Title = Maximum Potential|Cost = {{Money|11,350}}|Image = [[File:Soldier Upgrade 5 New.png|100px]]|Information = +2 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] +8 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|5,383}}}} ==Statistics== ''To see all the previous statistics of this tower, see the [[/History|history]] page.'' {{neow| $DPS$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Cooldown + (Firerate * Burst Count)) $DPS2$ = Damage / Firerate $CE$ = Total Cost / DPS $TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$ $COST$ = 450; It can, however, be used as a secondary DPS source to support your main DPS tower, depending on your loadout. *The '''Golden Soldier''' is able to change targets between bursts if another enemy enters its range. This avoids the need to swap targets from time to time. *The '''Golden Soldier's''' firerate can be boosted by the [[Commander]], but not its cooldown. *The '''Golden Soldier's''' flying detection allows it to effectively deal with flying enemies, like [[Balloon]]s and [[Balloon Kid]]s. **You may want several Level 4 '''Golden Soldiers''' to deal with the [[Balloon Kid]] due to their high health. ==Trivia== *The former Level 4 firerate without the [[Firerate Bug]] (0.076) and the Level 4 upgrade cost were references to [[w:c:Overwatch:Soldier: 76|Soldier: 76]] from ''Overwatch''. *The Level 4 upgrade name, "''Maximum Potential''", appears to be a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/meet-potential-man Potential Man] meme commonly tied to the '''Golden Soldier''' in the community. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' {{Scroll|text = *'''13 May 2022''' -
